Class TransactGetBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractTransactGetBuilder<TransactGetBuilder>
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.TransactGetBuilder
public class TransactGetBuilder extends AbstractTransactGetBuilder<TransactGetBuilder>
Builds a transactional get operation that reads up to 100 items atomically across one or more tables.

Obtain via DynamoSimplifiedClient.transactGet().

All items are retrieved in a single all-or-nothing transaction. If any item cannot be read, the entire transaction fails and no results are returned.

Note: DynamoDB's TransactGetItems API does not support ConsistentRead. This is an API-level limitation and cannot be worked around through any code path.

    • execute

      public @NonNull TransactGetResults<software.amazon.awssdk.enhanced.dynamodb.DynamoDbTable<?>> execute()
      Executes the transactional get operation.

      If any item has a projection expression configured via AbstractTransactGetBuilder.project(String...), the operation falls back to the low-level DynamoDB API to support attribute filtering.

      Returns:
      a TransactGetResults object providing typed access to retrieved items
